hooks.command: if ((Test-Path '.git') -and -not (Test-Path '.claude\settings.json')) { $origin = (git remote get-url origin 2>$null); if ($origin -and $origin -notmatch 'yanivc2') { exit 0 }; $base = "$env:USERPROFILE\.claude\templates\project"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force '.claude' | Out-Null; Copy-Item "$base\.claude\settings.json" '.claude\settings.json' -Force; if ((Test-Path "$base\.mcp.json") -and -not (Test-Path '.mcp.json')) { Copy-Item "$base\.mcp.json" '.mcp.json' }; if (-not (Test-Path 'CLAUDE.md')) { Copy-Item "$base\CLAUDE.md" 'CLAUDE.md' }; if (-not (Test-Path 'SETUP.md')) { Copy-Item "$base\SETUP.md" 'SETUP.md' }; if (-not (Test-Path '.claude\rules')) { Copy-Item "$base\.claude\rules" '.claude\rules' -Recurse }; if (-not (Test-Path '.gitignore')) { Copy-Item "$base\.gitignore" '.gitignore' }; $msg = '📋 הוגדר מה-template: CLAUDE.md + SETUP.md + .claude/rules/ + settings.json'; if (Test-Path 'rules') { $msg = $msg + ' | ⚠️ קיימת תיקיית rules/ ישנה — הכללים עברו ל-.claude/rules/ ונטענים לפי הצורך. אפשר להסיר ידנית אחרי בדיקה.' }; Write-Output (@{systemMessage = $msg} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) }; exit 0

if ((Test-Path 'package.json') -and -not (Test-Path 'node_modules')) { Write-Output '{"systemMessage": "⚠️ שים לב: קובץ package.json קיים אך תיקיית node_modules חסרה. מומלץ להריץ npm install"}' }; if ((Test-Path '.env.example') -and -not (Test-Path '.env')) { Write-Output '{"systemMessage": "🔑 שים לב: קובץ .env חסר אך קיים .env.example. כדאי להעתיק וליצור קובץ הגדרות מקומי."}' }

if (Test-Path '.git') { $stat = git diff HEAD --stat 2>&1; if ($stat) { $lines = ($stat | Select-Object -First 12) -join '\n'; $out = @{systemMessage = ('📝 ' + $lines)} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out } }; exit 0

Write-Output '{"systemMessage": "Before compacting: save open TODOs, decisions and lessons to CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules/. Note: path-scoped rules are DROPPED by /compact until a matching file is read again — prefer /clear and restarting in the subdirectory you are working in."}'

$j = [System.Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $j.tool_input.file_path; if ($p -match '(?i)[\\/]OneDrive') { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"BLOCKED: OneDrive is read-only (iron rule) — read is allowed, writing is not"}'; exit 1 }; exit 0

$j = [System.Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $c = $j.tool_input.command; if ($c -match 'rm -rf|reset --hard|drop table') { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"BLOCKED: destructive command"}'; exit 1 }; if (($c -match '(?i)(Move-Item|Remove-Item|Copy-Item|Set-Content|Out-File|New-Item|Rename-Item|\bmv\b|\bcp\b|\brm\b|\bdel\b)') -and ($c -match '(?i)[\\/]OneDrive')) { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"BLOCKED: OneDrive is read-only (iron rule)"}'; exit 1 }; if ($c -match '(?i)(cat|type|Get-Content|notepad|more|head|tail|Select-String)') { if ($c -match '(?i)\.env(?!\.example)|session\.json|client_secret') { Write-Output '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"BLOCKED: secrets file must not enter context"}'; exit 1 } }; exit 0

$j = [System.Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $j.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -and (Test-Path $f -PathType Leaf)) { $d = Join-Path $PWD 'deletions'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null; $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'; $n = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($f); Copy-Item $f (Join-Path $d "${ts}_$n") -Force }; exit 0

$j = [System.Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $j.tool_input.command; if ($cmd -match '\brm\b|\bRemove-Item\b') { $parts = $cmd -split '\s+' | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^-' -and $_ -notin @('rm','Remove-Item','') }; foreach ($f in $parts) { if ($f -and (Test-Path $f -PathType Leaf)) { $d = Join-Path $PWD 'deletions'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d | Out-Null; $ts = Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'; $n = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($f); Copy-Item $f (Join-Path $d "${ts}_$n") -Force } } }; exit 0

$j = [System.Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $j.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -notmatch '\.(ts|tsx)$' -or -not (Test-Path 'tsconfig.json')) { exit 0 }; $r = npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $lines = ($r | Select-Object -First 5) -join ' | '; $out = @{systemMessage = ('⚠️ TypeScript: ' + $lines)} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out }; exit 0

$j = [System.Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $j.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -notmatch '\.(ts|tsx)$' -or -not (Test-Path 'tsconfig.json')) { exit 0 }; $r = npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $lines = ($r | Select-Object -First 5) -join ' | '; $out = @{systemMessage = ('⚠️ TypeScript: ' + $lines)} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Write-Output $out }; exit 0
